defaultDescription.zh-CN: 飞抵基督城机场后直接入住哈特山脚梅思文布林克利度假村3晚，含2日哈特山全山雪票、Ōpuke地热温泉门票及机场往返雪场巴士，免租防滑链自驾即可轻松刷683米高海拔雪域。
defaultDescription.en: Fly into Christchurch and settle into Methven's Brinkley Resort for 3 nights with 2-day Mt Hutt lift passes, Ōpuke Thermal Pools entry, and airport plus mountain shuttle transfers—no snow chains required.
